title: Merge k Sorted Lists
prompt:
Merge `k` sorted linked lists into one sorted list and return its head.

**Example**: `[[1,4,5],[1,3,4],[2,6]]` → `[1,1,2,3,4,4,5,6]`.

A min-heap of the current head of each list: repeatedly poll the smallest and push its successor. O(N log k).
hints: Seed a min-heap (ordered by node value) with every non-null list head.
Poll the smallest node, append it to the result, and if it has a `next`, push that.
A dummy head keeps the result-building clean.

solution.explanation: The heap never holds more than k nodes (one frontier per list), so each of the N total nodes costs O(log k) to insert/extract: O(N log k). Splicing existing nodes (rather than copying values) keeps it O(k) extra space.
